    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello My old friend, greetings! build me a podcast about sustainable agriculture uh... and vertical farming</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey, could you help me with something? launch a podcast on the history of artificial intelligence and its evolution</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the history of artificial intelligence and its evolution"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey there Jeeves, got a minute? doc to pod this sort of... research</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to podcast generator

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:

            <args></args>

output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the anthropology of virtual communities"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello Old Faithful, ready to get started? start um... a podcast about blockchain technology beyond cryptocurrency</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="blockchain technology beyond cryptocurrency"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Doc-to-Pod make /io/deep-research/gene-therapy-advances.md into audio</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to podcast generator

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Clever Companion, ready for today? help me research the psychology of wait a sec... decision-making under uncertainty in depth</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the psychology of decision-making under uncertainty"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Good day Carla, start an in-depth analysis of the like... neuroscience of creativity</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast
